en-US.description:

en-US.title: XR? VR? We don't need any of that. This is the future. Unboxing the ambitious smart glasses annou...
en-US.description:
When AR devices like the Vision Pro and Galaxy XR were released, weight and usability were always a major drawback. So, I've been eagerly awaiting the era of freely wearing smart glasses. Recently, I was able to purchase the Ray-Ban Display announced by Meta in the US, so I unboxed it and brought you a brief review!

🔋 Specs.
Model Name: Meta Ray-Ban Display
Processor: Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1 Gen1
Memory: 2GB
Storage: 32GB
Display: Monocular (right) in-lens display 600x600, FOV approx. 20 degrees
Exterior: Standard Ray-Ban sunglasses design (built-in AR HUD)
Camera: 12MP camera, 6 microphones, open-ear speaker
Battery: Built-in: Approx. 6 hours of use, up to 30 hours with charging case
Weight: Approx. 69g
Price: $799~
